classes.label: Tue Nov 3 · Continue current Studios
classes.bring: Existing hosting/app repositories, SPEC/LEARNING and one actual result.
classes.work: Locate your next Studio checkpoint; revisit the small group content problem.
classes.review: A classmate asks what one actual result proves and what remains untested.
classes.update: Correct your existing record; do not create a duplicate baseline report.
classes.note: Both existing Studio deadlines are posted for Friday Nov 6 at 11:59 p.m.

classes.label: Thu Nov 5 · Studio workshop and groups
classes.bring: Current Studio progress, errors/checks and a feasible group ETL idea.
classes.work: Work on the posted lessons; confirm group members and a small content need.
classes.review: Try a peer task; record a useful issue and response.
classes.update: Keep actual checks, observations and help received in the existing files.
classes.note: The two separate Studio submissions remain due Nov 6. App Studio does not require deployment.

classes.label: Tue Nov 10 · Plan the next small workflow
classes.bring: Current app result, a user task and approved/synthetic group source ideas.
classes.work: Compare two approaches; agree reader, data, roles and success checks.
classes.review: Can a peer explain the main task and identify an assumption?
classes.update: Continue individual/shared records; assign comparable work and different reviewers.
classes.note: The next checkpoints are planned targets until Canvas posts their criteria and submission boxes.

classes.label: Thu Nov 12 · Plan workshop
classes.bring: Two approaches, three to five stories and a proposed work split.
classes.work: Refine scope and checks; keep a small source → transform → output path.
classes.review: A peer checks whether each story can pass or fail; respond to their issue.
classes.update: Choose a direction with a reason; update the same records.

classes.label: Tue Nov 17 · Planned Plan handoff; start Build
classes.bring: Chosen plans, current repositories and working starter/setup.
classes.work: Use the plan to build one main task; integrate small changes early.
classes.review: Check task owners, reviewers and observable expected results.
classes.update: Link current work and actual contributions; label unfinished behavior.
classes.note: All new handoffs remain planned until posted in Canvas.

classes.label: Thu Nov 19 · Build and cross-review
classes.bring: A/B workflow views and a small runnable slice.
classes.work: Try valid, rejected and relevant permission cases; integrate group slices.
classes.review: A real peer attempts the same task without coaching; partners cross-review.
classes.update: Record the observation, response, chosen approach and actual checks.

classes.label: Tue Nov 24 · Planned Build handoff; prepare release
classes.bring: Current builds, fixture inputs and open issues.
classes.work: Agree checked-release and handoff evidence before Thanksgiving.
classes.review: Can someone distinguish local tests, CI and actual hosted operation?
classes.update: Keep the chosen revision/setup and a small next action.
classes.note: No class Thursday Nov 26. Checked release is a planned delivery handoff, not a retroactive App Studio requirement.

classes.label: Tue Dec 1 · Checked-release workshop
classes.bring: Chosen revision, setup, actual check results and current limits.
classes.work: Reproduce the agreed run and improve delivery evidence on existing infrastructure.
classes.review: A peer reproduces a task and questions what one check establishes.
classes.update: Resolve real failures; keep local/CI/hosted claims separate.

classes.label: Thu Dec 3 · Planned release handoff
classes.bring: Current records, working links and the next real peer-review task.
classes.work: Review the chosen release and prepare final walkthroughs and rehearsal.
classes.review: Check version identity, setup, source trace and remaining issues.
classes.update: Name the actual contribution and next fix; no new project.
classes.note: Dec 8/10 are protected finishing/review classes; no new topic.

classes.label: Tue Dec 8 · Protected work and peer reviews
classes.bring: Both working projects, one task per review and open issues.
classes.work: Catch up, finish workflows and make meaningful feedback-driven changes.
classes.review: A real peer tries each task; partners take comparable design/development/QA roles.
classes.update: Link issue → response → change → retest and current contributions.
classes.note: No new topic, stack or feature. Final readiness Dec 10 at 11:59 p.m. is a planned target.

classes.label: Thu Dec 10 · Protected finish and rehearse
classes.bring: Final links, review evidence, setup and a short demo story.
classes.work: Finish fixes, retest and rehearse both projects and each contribution.
classes.review: Verify links and one meaningful improvement; state unfinished work honestly.
classes.update: Keep the same URLs current for the Dec 18 demo.
classes.note: Planned final readiness is tonight at 11:59 p.m.; this is not a deadline before class. Canvas will confirm actual submissions.

classes.label: Fri Dec 18 · Posted Demo Day / final period
classes.bring: Working project links, chosen revision, setup and contribution evidence.
classes.work: Demonstrate the user task, actual check and real improvement.
classes.review: Each person explains their own choices and work.
classes.update: Record any instructor-requested follow-up without changing the historical evidence.
classes.note: Posted time: 8:30–11 a.m. Eastern. Follow Canvas for confirmed delivery/joining arrangements.
